newsitem.title: USA: Nat'l Quality Care had no Fresenius talks.
newsitem.headline: Nat'l Quality Care had no Fresenius talks.

text.p: National Quality Care Inc said Thursday it has held no discussions regarding a possible acquisition, or combination/joint venture of any form with Fresenius AG.
The company also said it withheld comment as to its interest or intent in pursuing such discussions, either now, or in the future.

National Quality Care said its comment is in response to a statement issued Wednesday in which Fresenius, headquartered in Bad Homburg, Germany, said it would sell two million shares of preferred stock to fund its expansion into the $65 billion dollar market for dialysis services in the United States.
Following its acquisition of W.R. Grace & Co's dialysis unit in 1996, Fresenius is believed to be the world's largest manufacturer of dialysis equipment.
National Quality Care noted the Fresenius' statement did not mention any acquisition candidates by name.

However, it continued, analysts pointed to several publicly traded companies as potential takeover candidates, including National Quality Care, which has received numerous inquiries regarding this subject.
